messages:
rhea (design): dropping a new compact-flow sketch: "mini roles drawer" — tiny header, role dropdown, email input, Add. No giant matrix unless Advanced clicked. Link: https://figma.com/file/mini-roles-ux
omar (pm): I like the lower cognitive load. Question: what happens if admin needs to set multiple roles for the same invite?
rhea (design): Advanced opens the full matrix modal. Mini drawer handles single-role invites only. microcopy under input: 'Invite one person at a time. For bulk invites use Advanced.'
vik (frontend): easy to implement. /invite?mode=mini&role=editor to prefill. Will ensure focus lands on email input.
nina (a11y): accessibility notes: dropdown must have aria-expanded + aria-controls and the drawer should set aria-modal when open. Make sure dynamic help text announces via aria-live polite.
kai (research): past tests showed single-field flows increase completions ~7%. Recommend A/B: mini-drawer vs current drawer. Track completion and time-to-invite.
omar (pm): SSO nuance — for orgs with enforced SSO, show a subtle lock badge in mini drawer: 'SSO required'. Not blocking but clear.
rhea (design): badge mock: lock icon + tooltip "SSO enforced for this organization". Tooltip on hover/focus with more details.
nina (a11y): tooltip must be reachable by keyboard and have role="tooltip" with aria-describedby pointing to content. Also use role="status" when drawer opens to announce SSO state.
vik (frontend): will implement badge as a status element and add a docs link. If SSO policy forbids external emails we should show soft validation: 'This email may require SSO' with CTA 'Review SSO settings'.
omar (pm): audit trace: there is demand to surface recent role changes. Propose a link 'Recent role edits' next to mini drawer header that opens audit prefiltered to role_change&range=14d.
rhea (design): visual idea: small hovercard with last 3 anonymized events (actor + action + relative time). On focus show as accessible list.
nina (a11y): hovercard must not trap keyboard and should be read as a list; masked entries should have a 'show details' control for permitted users. Use aria-hidden toggles appropriately.
kai (research): mask emails by default in the preview. Owners can click through to see full data in audit page. We'll instrument clicks for funnel metrics.
vik (frontend): note: ensure prefiltered audit link performs a permission check client-side and server enforces masking; if user lacks permission show inline tooltip 'Request audit access'.
deploy-bot: preview deployed at https://staging.redwood.tools/mini-drawer/2399 build#5340 (keyboard + aria updates included)
vik (frontend): quick QA in staging: 1) NVDA reads the drawer twice on open (likely duplicate aria-label). 2) hovercard doesn't close on Esc. Fixing now.
rhea (design): will tweak DOM so heading isn't duplicated for screen readers. Also creating two header copy variants: 'Add a teammate' vs 'Invite one person' for the experiment.
omar (pm): timeline: can we get a QA branch by Tue EOD? Priorities: keyboard flow, SSO badge announcement, audit prefilter gating.
nina (a11y): I'll run a NVDA + VoiceOver pass when vik flags the branch. Prepare a short checklist (focus order, live region messages, tooltip behavior) and post back.
kai (research): I'll wire analytics events: mini_drawer_open, invite_submit, audit_preview_click. We'll set thresholds and sample rates.
rhea (design): thanks team. pushing updated figma with a11y notes and anonymized preview copy. post the staging link and any follow-ups here. :seedling:
